lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ti6Ge2Ir2 (Ti3GeIr) adopts the tetragonal I-4m2 space group (No. 119), with 10 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ge and Ir centers each with 8 Ti neighbors, while Ti centers have 12 neighbors (4 Ge, 4 Ir, 4 Ti), forming a 3D connected network. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal Ti–Ti 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and Ge–Ir 8-vertex polyhedra sharing corners and faces.
